1 Executive Summary & Objectives

The Student Performance & CGPA Prediction System is an end-to-end predictive machine learning framework designed to forecast undergraduate students' Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA on a standard 0.0 – 10.0 scale). By combining historical scholastic aptitude, continuous engagement indicators, and lifestyle factors, the model pinpoints academic vulnerabilities early in the semester, enabling timely interventions.

2 Dataset Architecture & Feature Specification

The predictive pipeline operates on 14 fundamental input dimensions expanding into 18 modeled features across academic, behavioral, and demographic spheres:

Input Dimension Data Type Domain / Range Educational & Behavioral Rationale
high_school_gpaFloat0.0 – 10.0Foundational cognitive aptitude and pre-university work ethic.
entrance_exam_scoreFloat40 – 100Standardized competitive testing and problem-solving readiness.
course_loadInteger12 – 21 creditsAcademic pressure and semester credit weight.
attendance_rateFloat40 – 100%Direct instructional contact and classroom engagement.
weekly_study_hoursFloat0 – 45 hrsSelf-directed independent revision and assignment mastery.
class_participationInteger1 – 10 ratingIn-class interactive questioning and active learning.
assignment_submission_rateFloat30 – 100%Continuous assessment compliance and homework diligence.
extracurricular_hoursFloat0 – 20 hrsCo-curricular balance (clubs, athletic engagement, volunteering).
daily_sleep_hoursFloat3 – 10 hrsRestorative rest facilitating cognitive retention and mental wellness.
part_time_work_hoursFloat0 – 35 hrsEmployment time-commitment competing with study schedules.
commute_time_minutesFloat0 – 100 minsDaily transit fatigue factor impacting energy levels.
screen_time_hoursFloat0 – 14 hrsNon-academic digital leisure screen time.
majorCategorical5 CategoriesEngineering, Business, Arts, Science, Social Science (one-hot encoded).
family_income_levelCategoricalLow, Middle, HighSocioeconomic tier influencing access to supplementary resources.
Data Cleaning & Transformation Protocol (preprocessing_module.py):
  • Imputation: Numerical features missing values replaced via median; categoricals via mode.
  • Dummy Encoding: pd.get_dummies(..., drop_first=True) eliminates collinearity.
  • Z-Score Standardization: StandardScaler centers all predictors to μ = 0, σ = 1.
  • Domain Bounding: Output strictly constrained to valid academic range: y ∈ [0.0, 10.0].

3 Machine Learning Models Evaluated

Four candidate regression architectures were comprehensively benchmarked with 80% training data, 20% holdout testing data, and 5-fold cross-validation:

1. Lasso Regression (L1 Regularization) - Selected

Minimizes MSE plus absolute sum of coefficient weights:

Loss = (1/2n) ||Xw - y||² + α ||w||₁

Strength: Performs automatic feature selection by zeroing out non-informative coefficients, eliminating noise and multicollinearity.

2. Ridge Regression (L2 Regularization)

Minimizes MSE plus squared Euclidean norm:

Loss = ||Xw - y||² + α ||w||₂²

Strength: Proportionally shrinks weights across correlated features (e.g. study hours & attendance) without dropping them entirely.

3. Linear Regression (OLS)

Unregularized Ordinary Least Squares closed-form baseline:

w* = (XᵀX)⁻¹ Xᵀy

Strength: Unbiased reference baseline indicating empirical upper bounds of pure linear combinations.

4. Random Forest Regressor

Non-linear ensemble of 200 bootstrapped decision trees:

ŷ = (1/B) Σ f_b(x), B = 200 trees

Strength: Detects non-linear thresholds, but suffers slight boundary compression on continuous grade distributions.

5 Model Performance & Interpretability Diagnostics

Validation metrics establish that the trained Lasso estimator achieves high predictive fidelity with an average deviation (MAE) of only 0.2872 grade points on a 10.0 scale.

Figure 2: Actual vs. Predicted CGPA scatter plot showing tight clustering along the 45° ideal regression identity line (R² = 0.736).
Figure 3: Regression coefficient weights indicating primary positive drivers (GPA, study hours) and detractor features (screen time, work hours).

Behavioral & Pedagogical Insights:

  • Prior Academic Foundation (β ≈ +0.42): high_school_gpa is the single most influential predictor, confirming that cumulative discipline formed in secondary school is persistent.
  • Consistent Academic Engagement (β ≈ +0.35 cumulative): weekly_study_hours, attendance_rate, and assignment_submission_rate jointly drive positive academic outcomes.
  • Detractors & Risk Indicators: Increased screen_time_hours (-0.035) and part_time_work_hours (-0.025) create direct temporal friction against study time.
Figure 4: Inter-Feature Correlation Heatmap demonstrating collinear relationships across academic and lifestyle variables.

6 Full-Stack Production Architecture & Zero-Downtime Fallback

The production system connects a React 19 + Vite frontend to an Express REST API backend with an autonomous fault-tolerant ML runtime:

Zero-Downtime Resilience Protocol (backend/controllers/predictionController.js):

1. Primary Inference Route: Node.js spawns a Python child process running predict.py with serialized artifacts (model.pkl, scaler.pkl).

2. Autonomous Fallback Engine: If the Python interpreter or OS dependencies are unreachable, the controller instantly engages an exact mathematical regression formula:

CGPA_est = 0.80 + 0.42·GPA + 0.012·Exam + 0.035·StudyHrs + 0.009·Attendance + 0.009·Submissions - 0.025·WorkHrs - 0.035·ScreenTime - 0.005·Commute + IncomeFactor

3. Database Resiliency: If MongoDB is temporarily offline, predictions seamlessly cache into an in-memory queue, preventing UI interruption.

8 Conclusion & Artifact Deliverables

  • Champion Model: Lasso Regression provides the highest test R² (0.7359), lowest RMSE (0.3581), and optimal model interpretability.
  • Serialized Deliverables: Serialized model weights (model/model.pkl), standard scaler (model/scaler.pkl), and feature schema (model/feature_names.txt).
  • Full-Stack Integration: Live REST endpoints at /api/predictions and /api/predict with complete React 19 UI integration.
